name: things-bridge
description: Let Claude read and manage your Things 3 to-dos, using only the methods Cultured Code documents as safe. Never deletes anything.
long_description:
Connects Claude to [Things 3](https://culturedcode.com/things/) on this Mac through the **things-bridge** command-line tool. It uses only the methods Cultured Code documents as safe for third-party AI tools: it reads with read-only AppleScript and writes with the Things URL scheme. It never opens the Things database, and it never deletes anything.

**Before you install**
- Install things-bridge with `uv tool install git+https://github.com/sethschrage/things-bridge`. This extension runs `~/.local/bin/things-bridge mcp`; it contains no code of its own, so `uv tool upgrade things-bridge` updates it.
- To let Claude change existing to-dos, store your Things auth token in your login Keychain: run `things-bridge token set` in Terminal. The extension never asks for the token and never stores it. Adding new to-dos works without it.
- The first time Claude reads Things, macOS asks whether Claude may control Things. Click **OK**.

**What Claude can do**
- Read Inbox, Today, Anytime, Upcoming, Someday and the Logbook; search; list projects, areas and tags; find items by tag, project, area or deadline
- Add to-dos and projects; change titles, notes, dates, tags and checklists (append or prepend); complete, cancel or reopen; schedule; move; open items in Things

**Guardrails**
- Nothing is ever deleted. Cancel is the reversible alternative, or Claude opens the item in Things so you can delete it yourself.
- Every change is read back from Things and reported as verified or not. Nothing is retried automatically.
- Batches of more than 10 items need an explicit confirmation.
- The schedule, deadline and status of repeating to-dos are never changed.
- *Read-only mode* registers only the tools that read Things and open items in it.

**Privacy**: things-bridge runs on your Mac and has no servers of its own. What Claude reads from Things (titles, notes, tags, dates) becomes part of your conversation and is processed by Anthropic like anything else you share with Claude.

things-bridge is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cultured Code.

tools.name: things_list
tools.description: To-dos and projects in Inbox, Today, Anytime, Upcoming or Someday

tools.name: things_logbook
tools.description: Recently completed and canceled to-dos and projects

tools.name: things_get
tools.description: One to-do, project or area with full notes, optionally with its children

tools.name: things_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally only those in one area

tools.name: things_areas
tools.description: List areas

tools.name: things_tags
tools.description: List tags

tools.name: things_search
tools.description: Search titles and notes, optionally including the recent Logbook

tools.name: things_find
tools.description: Find to-dos and projects by tags, project or area

tools.name: things_deadlines
tools.description: Open items with a deadline, soonest (overdue) first

tools.name: things_doctor
tools.description: Check the setup, read-only; can bring up the macOS permission dialog

tools.name: things_add_todo
tools.description: Add a to-do

tools.name: things_add_todos
tools.description: Add several to-dos at once

tools.name: things_add_project
tools.description: Add a project, optionally with to-dos and headings

tools.name: things_update_todo
tools.description: Change a to-do's title, notes, dates, tags, checklist (append or prepend) or container

tools.name: things_update_project
tools.description: Change a project's title, notes, dates, tags or area

tools.name: things_set_status
tools.description: Complete, cancel or reopen to-dos and projects (all reversible)

tools.name: things_schedule
tools.description: Set when (with an optional reminder) and deadline, or clear the deadline

tools.name: things_move
tools.description: Move to-dos into a project or area, or projects into an area

tools.name: things_tag
tools.description: Add or replace tags (existing tags only)

tools.name: things_json
tools.description: Send a Things JSON command (projects and areas by id only)

tools.name: things_show
tools.description: Open an item, list, area, project or tag in the Things window

tools.name: things_open_search
tools.description: Open Things' own search window

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Register only the tools that read Things and open items in it: Claude can't add or change anything. Same as `things-bridge mcp --read-only`.
